picks.name: Le Motel
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Constellation Tatsu. Similar ambient/field-recording territory to your Brian d'Souza and Andrew Pekler-adjacent picks.
picks.bio: Brussels-based producer, composer and field recordist. "Pozo de Agua" (September 15, 2026) was largely made outdoors and on trains -- ripples, water drops, movement and air treated with the same weight as instruments, drifting in and out to form subtle polyrhythms and overlapping textures.
picks.why_listen: Immersive, environmentally-sourced ambient that rewards close listening -- ideal for an opening set or a contemplative wind-down.

picks.name: Overmono
picks.source_note: New artist discovery: XL Recordings. Similar UK electronic/breakbeat territory to your HAAi and Max Cooper picks.
picks.bio: UK duo (brothers Tom and Ed Russell) at the top table of British electronic music. "Pure Devotion" (August 7, 2026, XL Recordings) is their second album -- 11 tracks spanning ambient, breakbeat hardcore and techno, pairing pummelling beats and chest-rattling bass with tender chords and guest vocals from John Joseph Holt, Jaz Karis and Kindora.
picks.why_listen: Big, emotionally direct dance music with real pop instincts -- anthemic peak-time material that also has genuine downtempo moments.
